items.name: Senpai Gloves
items.description:
Lore: Crafted of the finest black fox-hide and engraved with beautiful golden stitched flowers, these loudly-elven gloves enhance the wearer's magical abilities noticeably. 

 

Disable Device +5
Sleight of Hand +5
Attacks with Touch Spells: +2
Resistance: The gloves are indestructible. The wearer's hands are immune to fire, cold, shock, and acid damage and can handle cursed or cross-aligned items without effect.
Potency: If the wearer delivers a touch attack via the gloves, that spell's DC is i

items.name: Mask of the Unquenchable Fire
items.description:
Various lenses rotate into position over the eyes and change colors according to current function. 

The Goggles are covered in tiny dark-grey runes that glow faintly white when unlocked. Categories are labelled in Elven. 

Knowledge:
Eyes of the Eagle: +5 perception. Always on.
Low Light vision, activates if wearer does not possess this power.
Darkvision, activates if wearer does not possess this power. 60' or extends 30'.

Lust:
Elvenkind: +5 spellcraft (must be able to speak Elven). Always on
